schema.name: The Basis of Organizational Restructuring in 2027
schema.description: A free live online class on the basis of organizational restructuring, helping business leaders understand when a business needs restructuring and what a rebuilt structure looks like ahead of 2027.

sections.heading: Why This Class
paragraphs: Most businesses do not restructure for fun. They restructure because growth has outpaced the structure, reporting lines exist on paper but not in practice, or nobody can explain who actually decides what.

This free online class lays out the basis of organizational restructuring: how to recognise the signs, what a properly rebuilt structure is made of, and how to start preparing your business for 2027 before the new financial year is already underway.

entries.title: Signs You Need to Restructure
entries.text: Growth outpacing structure, unclear reporting lines, and decisions that stall.

entries.title: Governance and Decision Rights
entries.text: Who decides what, and where authority actually sits.

entries.title: Organograms and Reporting Lines
entries.text: Redrawing the structure so it matches how the business really runs.

entries.title: Roles, JDs and KPIs
entries.text: Defining roles with clear accountability, not inherited job titles.

entries.title: Policies and Performance Systems
entries.text: Staff policy and performance measures that fit the new structure.

entries.title: Planning Ahead for 2027
entries.text: Where to start, and how to roll a restructuring out without disrupting the business.

entries.title: Business Owners and CEOs
entries.text: Leaders whose business has grown beyond its original structure.

entries.title: HR and Operations Leaders
entries.text: People responsible for roles, reporting lines and policy.

entries.title: Founders and Managing Directors
entries.text: Teams preparing to scale, take on investment or merge entities.

entries.q: What is The Basis of Organizational Restructuring in 2027?
entries.a: It is a free online class by Traction Outsourcing Limited on the fundamentals of organizational restructuring: how to tell when a business needs it, and what a properly rebuilt structure looks like, so leaders can plan for the 2027 financial year with a structure that fits the business.

entries.q: When and where does the class hold?
entries.a: The class holds live on Google Meet on Friday, 16 October 2026, at 3:00 PM WAT.
Yes. The class is free to attend. You only need to register with your name, organization, phone number, email address and state of residence.
Business owners, CEOs, MDs, founders, HR leaders and operations managers who suspect their current structure no longer fits the business, or who are planning ahead for 2027.
